Registration._comment: Kurum kaydi kotuye kullanim kapilari. DailyHardLimit mesru hacmin cok ustunde olmali; dusuk tutulursa tek saldirgan tavani yakip gercek kayitlari engeller.

TenantCleanup._comment: Destructive rejected-registration cleanup is opt-in. Keep disabled in production unless a reviewed retention run is explicitly approved.

AccountDeletion._comment: Personal-account deletion finalizer. For KVKK (silme hakki) + App Store 5.1.1(v) compliance this MUST be set to true in production so a deletion request actually completes; left false here so enabling is a deliberate deploy step. GracePeriodDays is the cancellable window (account removed when it elapses). Disable only for a short maintenance window.

InstitutionDeletion._comment: Institution (tenant) deletion finalizer. Set to true in production so an approved institution-deletion completes after its grace window; left false here so enabling is a deliberate deploy step.
